mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id_config, c.id_site, m.id_device, m.current_parameter, m.current_phase_a_parameter, m.current_phase_b_parameter, m.current_phase_c_parameter, m.current_issue_threshold, m.voltage_parameter, m.voltage_phase_a_parameter, m.voltage_phase_b_parameter, m.voltage_phase_c_parameter, m.voltage_issue_threshold, m.power_factor_parameter, m.power_factor_phase_a_parameter, m.power_factor_phase_b_parameter, m.power_factor_phase_c_parameter, m.power_factor_issue_threshold FROM troubleshooting_config c INNER JOIN troubleshooting_main_meter_config m ON m.id_config = c.id WHERE c.id_site = #{_parameter} AND c.id_config_type = 1 AND c.is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM troubleshooting_config WHERE id_site = #{_parameter} AND id_config_type = 1 AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 FROM troubleshooting_config WHERE id_site = #{_parameter} AND id_config_type = 1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO troubleshooting_config (id_site, id_config_type, version, is_active) VALUES (#{id_site}, 1, #{version}, 1)
